name: bmm_chunk
description: Per-chunk batched Gram matrix with signature bmm_chunk(a, b, chunk_size, causal=False). a and b have shape [batch, seqlen, ngroups, k] with seqlen divisible by chunk_size. Split the token axis into chunks and compute, for every batch, chunk, group and row pair (i,j), out[batch, chunk, group, i, j] = sum_k a[batch, chunk*chunk_size+i, group, k] * b[batch, chunk*chunk_size+j, group, k], accumulated in float32 and stored in a.dtype. The output is newly allocated with shape [batch, seqlen//chunk_size, ngroups, chunk_size, chunk_size] and dtype a.dtype. causal=False schedules every tile and fills the whole matrix. causal=True uses an upper-triangular tile schedule (tile row index <= tile column index), guaranteeing the i <= j region. Full diagonal tiles can also write some i > j entries, while unscheduled lower tiles remain unspecified in the empty-allocated output; the lower triangle is not guaranteed to be zero. The causal correctness check compares only the i <= j region and ignores i > j. The exercised dtype is bfloat16 and inputs are not modified.
